payload.text: fleet's DEVBIN_FLEET_FROZEN MATCHES AN ESTATE'S BASENAME, ${root##*/}, while the plan names estates by LABEL and echoes the declared list in its header (driven 2026-10-07). Declared as the plan's label, an estate under a subdirectory stayed "upgrade + repoint" with "0 frozen" in the summary, while the header read "frozen: <the label>". Freeze by basename, and before any --apply run the plan again and read the summary's frozen count and the estate's FROZEN row: the header proves nothing. Filed as 0182; until it lands, this holds.
